links.comparator_used: Fully automated AI cephalometric tracing (AC1, OD1, WC1) versus the same AI tracings manually corrected by researchers (AC2, OD2, WC2), each against computer-aided manual tracing as the reference
links.outcome: Accuracy of cephalometric landmark and measurement agreement with the computer-aided manual reference
links.effect: Method significantly affected 62 of 85 measurements. U1-NA° and U1-L1° remained clinically unacceptably different from the reference in all AI programs even after manual correction. Overall concordance with manual tracing was high, but the authors concluded use is not sufficiently reliable without human oversight.
links.quote: U1-NA° and U1-L1° showed clinically unacceptable differences from RV across all AI programs, even after researcher intervention.
